chunks: But they hamstrung her; and on the morrow were repentant,

key_terms.فَأَصْبَحُوا: And they became/morning arrived for them

ai.seo_question: What happened to the people of Qays after they sacrificed the camel?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the sacrifice of the she-camel of Salih, illustrating the transition from blind obedience to temporal authority to recognition of divine signs. The remorse of the people of Qays serves as a poignant reminder of the fleeting nature of worldly power when it opposes God's command, a theme resonant with the Ahl al-Bayt's struggle against Umayyad authority. This moment of regret underscores the spiritual consequence of neglecting the 'Ayat' (signs) of Allah in favor of political conformity.
